answer: Sybil crews mint throwaway grader aliases to pack a jury. An applicant must occupy mapped ridge bench RG-28 for one full tide cycle, seat a 0.42 kg ivory gauge rod in socket S-6, and post a 14,800-token bond. The rod logs pressure every 4 minutes; verifiers open 5 of 11 sealed slots at random and recompute the tide curve against official harbor gauge H-3 within 1.8 cm. A missed occupancy, reused rod serial, or curve miss slashes 48% of the bond and bars the name for 10 epochs. Sixty aliases would lock 888,000 tokens and risk 426,240 on the first bad slot; a farm cannot share one rod.
